title: Burning Soul
summary: Deep in the Tidal Abyss, Da Lou Sword Sect disciples led by Chen Long have been trapped by beasts for a hundred years under Tan Lang, a cultivator fallen from Illusory Yin who waits for Ling Tianhou to come for them. At the Water Demon Country entrance Wang Lin meets Du Jian of the Tianyun Sect's Red Division, Murong Zhuo of the Ink Sect, and Zhao Yixuan and Xu Fei of the Floating Cloud Sect, and joins them. Du Jian leads them to a supposed Tianyun Sword lost by Sun Yun of the Purple Division, but it is a trap set on a poison-insect tree, which Wang Lin sees through; he parts from the group after warning Murong Zhuo that the two women are Corpse Yin Sect, one a puppet. Guided by Bei Lou's jade slip, Wang Lin finds Zhou Yi's sword spirit sealed deep under a rock wall by Ling Tianhou's divine sense, at least late Nirvana Cleanser in strength. Against Xu Liguo's pleas he burns his own divine soul, using his immortal art and Origin Soul with the Immobilization Technique, the Yellow Springs and the golden talismans to trap Ling Tianhou's divine sense and break the seal on Zhou Yi.
events: Chen Long's Da Lou disciples beg Tan Lang to lead them out of the abyss
Wang Lin enters the Tidal Abyss with Du Jian, Murong Zhuo, Zhao Yixuan and Xu Fei
Du Jian's Tianyun Sword turns out to be a poison-insect trap
Wang Lin exposes the trap and leaves the group
He warns Murong Zhuo that the two women are Corpse Yin Sect
He finds Zhou Yi sealed by Ling Tianhou's divine sense
He burns his divine soul to trap Ling Tianhou's divine sense and reach Zhou Yi
cultivation: Tan Lang: fell from Illusory Yin, now great perfection Ascendant. Chen Long and Murong Zhuo: early Ascendant. Si She, Xu Gou and Zhao Yixuan: late Soul Transformation. You Ji and Xu Fei: mid Soul Transformation. Du Jian and Wu Ma: great perfection Soul Transformation. Ling Tianhou is judged to be at least late Nirvana Cleanser.
